summary: Regression-tested SafeTap backend and mobile preview. Backend readiness, all three demo logins, scan analysis, and protected overview authorization passed; victim UI scan rendered the reported-threat result.

integration_issues.flow: Role switching immediately followed by login
integration_issues.issue: Focused automation loop hit a timing-sensitive failure after switching roles; the role change updates email through useEffect and login was attempted immediately. Victim flow itself passed. Needs explicit role-login retest with a short state wait.

action_items: Retest investigator and admin login after waiting for the role-derived email state to update, or derive the login email directly from the selected role.
Align frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current code uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and preview-only extra fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API URL does not read EXPO_BACKEND_URL as required by the environment contract.
OpenPhish/PhishTank matching and AI explanation are MOCKED fallback behavior when feed/key integrations are unavailable.
The UI login email is synchronized in useEffect after role selection, creating a possible immediate-submit race.

success_rate.frontend: Partial: victim flow passed; investigator/admin loop inconclusive due role-state timing

seed_data_creation: One scan case was created by the regression scan test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Preview tested at https://threat-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com on mobile viewport 375x667. Backend suite passed. Victim scan displayed score 68, Recently Reported Threat, known/reported phishing, and factors.
rca_of_issue: The role selector calls setRole, while email is updated in a separate useEffect. A login tap in the same event window can submit the previous role's email, causing authentication failure. This is a frontend state synchronization risk, not a backend failure.
